discussion_comments.comment_body: This unconditional replacement can let an older in-flight poll overwrite the newer optimistic result from create/mutate. Track a request generation or reconcile against newer local mutations before accepting this response.

This fetch races the `refreshTasks` effect below after `setSelectedBoardSlug(initialSlug)`, so initial load requests the same board twice and either response can win. Please use one request owner and guard results against a later board selection.

`hydrateFromStoredSession()` awaits REST and then replaces `messages` (`desktop-controller.tsx:508-515`), but the WebSocket listener is already live after reconnect. A delta received while that request is pending can be overwritten by the older snapshot. Please make the hydrate response generation-aware or otherwise preserve newer live updates.
